This pertains to your letter seeking this Department's opinion on whether or not it is necessary for this Department to implement the Ombudsman decision in OMB-L-A-10-0053-E entitled: "Public Assistance and Corruption Preventive Office (PACPO-LUZON) vs. Eric O. Sibuma, et al." considering that Engr. Noel D. Mamaril one of the respondents therein is a permanent employee of the municipality of Aringay. Per your letter Mayor Teresita A. Ong of the Municipality of Aringay has not yet acted upon the suspension of Engr. Noel D. Mamaril as ordered by the Office of the Deputy Ombudsman for Luzon in OMB-L-A-IO-0053. However, after a careful review of the said Ombudsman decision, we find out that it was the Honorable Secretary of this Department who was directed to implement the same. In that regard, please be informed that since it was the Honorable Secretary of this Department who was directed by the Office of the Ombudsman to implement their decision, then it should be this Department which will implement the same. Please be informed further that this Department already issued a Memorandum addressed to OIC-Regional Director Julie J. Daquioag of DILG-Region I dated January 18, 2012, directing her to implement the above-mentioned Ombudsman decision. We hope we have guided you accordingly.
